Segment-level recall, precision and F1 against ground truth

Source: R/05b_groundtruth_metrics.R
pam_recall_metrics.Rd

The unit is a segment x species: a species is "detected" in a segment if the detector has an event of that species overlapping the segment at or above the threshold, and "present" if the annotator marked it. Possibly-present pairs are left out of the counts.

Usage

pam_recall_metrics(
  truth,
  segments,
  events,
  classes = NULL,
  thresholds = c(0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7)
)

Arguments

truth

Annotation table (segment_id, present, possible).

segments

Segment table (segment_id, rel, seg_start, seg_end).

events

Detector events from pam_validation_pool() (rel, start_time, end_time, scientific_name, confidence).

classes

Scientific names of the classifier's classes.

thresholds

Confidence thresholds to evaluate.

Value

A data.table with one row per species (and "ALL", summed over species) and threshold: tp, fn, fp, tn, n_present, recall, recall_low, recall_high, precision, precision_low, precision_high, f1.

Details

With simple random sampling of segments the estimates apply to the sampled recordings and hours. A species that is rarely present in random segments has few n_present and an uncertain recall.
